title: Northern lights
text: The northern lights (aurora borealis) are caused by charged particles from the sun colliding with gases in Earth's upper atmosphere.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Plants convert sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen through photosynthesis in chloroplasts.

title: llama.cpp decision models
text: Decision models in llama.cpp score typed options via POST /v1/systemone instead of generating free-form tokens.

title: JEPA world models
text: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn to predict latent future states; JEPA-Anything adds orthogonal predictive factorization across domains.

title: PixelUMM
text: PixelUMM is an encoder-free multimodal model that understands and generates images and video directly in pixel space with a Qwen3-8B backbone.

title: Vector embeddings
text: Embedding models map text or other modalities into dense vectors so cosine similarity can rank related documents for search and RAG.

title: Bun runtime
text: Bun is a fast JavaScript runtime and package manager often used as a drop-in alternative to Node for Vite apps.

title: Matryoshka embeddings
text: Matryoshka Representation Learning lets you truncate embedding dimensions (e.g. 768 to 256) and re-normalize with limited quality loss.
